title: Concept: Subprocess invoked with shell=True in python — review required
description: In python, subprocess runs with shell=True. The shell re-parses the command, so any `;`, `|`, `&&`, or `$()` in a concatenated value starts a new command. The option is often added to make pipes convenient and then stays while the argument list grows to include request data.
applicability: python services and jobs that invoke external programs.
risk: Shell injection with application privileges; HIGH severity.
